campaign.title: M1 lower-cone three-variable Hessian dispersion gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use primary multidimensional exponential-sum, van der Corput, Poisson, decoupling, and monomial-sum sources only after matching the literal t-d-e coefficient, squarefree and coprimality support, strict cone, nearest-square mask, profile, individual complex direction, and full R-M-T-D-E power ledger. Record theorem number, dimension, derivative determinant, box aspect ratios, coefficient class, smoothing, exceptional ranges, and boundary losses.

frozen_target.question: Does the exact Round-145 small-t survivor admit a genuinely nondegenerate three-variable dispersion estimate in the t-d-e variables that makes a strict intermediate-t range target-safe, or even proves the target; if not, what is the first exact coefficient, mask, aspect-ratio, boundary, theorem-hypothesis, transform-return, or power obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Let R=X^(1/4), N=floor X, I_M=N intersect [M,B_M), B_M<=2M, k_(s,t)=floor(t sqrt(Ns)+1/2), and j_(s,t)=k_(s,t)^2-Nst^2. The exact open scalar is sum_M sum_(1<=t<M^(1/4)) sum_(s squarefree, st^2 in I_M, |j_(s,t)|>M^(3/4)) (st^2)^(-3/4)V_low(R^2st^2/N)C(st^2)e(t sqrt(Ns)), where C(st^2) has the accepted multiplicity-one squarefree-common-kernel and full-gcd formulas. On de=s the phase is f(t,d,e)=sqrt(N)t sqrt(de).
quantities: On a dyadic box t asymp T, d asymp D, e asymp E with DE asymp M/T^2, the coefficient-blind weighted upper price is X^epsilon M^(1/4)/T. Any target claim must account for every box and the logarithmic assembly.

In relative coordinates ordered as t,d,e, the scaled Hessian f^(-1)diag(t,d,e)(nabla^2 f)diag(t,d,e) equals [[0,1/2,1/2],[1/2,-1/4,1/4],[1/2,1/4,-1/4]] and has determinant 1/4. This algebraic nondegeneracy is only a candidate interface, not an estimate.

The exact coefficient for fixed t,d,e contains the gamma,a,b factor count, parity, character, coprimality, and strict cone. Treating it as a smooth separable amplitude, arbitrary bounded coefficient, or independent tensor requires proof.

The nearest-square mask is a discontinuous condition depending on t,d,e. It may be removed or smoothed only with an owner-complete boundary estimate; the Round-144 target-safe small-displacement result does not control a new internal partition automatically.

The t=1 and bounded-t faces collapse the three-variable box and remain mandatory. A theorem requiring all three side lengths to grow can at most prove a strict intermediate-t reduction unless the boundary is handled separately.
The exact family N=sL^2+1 produces surviving slowly rotating phases and must be tested against any derivative lower bound, dual separation, or uniform Diophantine hypothesis.
The individual positive direction e(+t sqrt(Nde)) at the fixed centre N=floor X is required. Cosine, conjugate-pair, centre-average, mean-square, or coefficient-blind estimates do not substitute.

Round 141 already found rank-one behavior in the two-variable product phase. This round may use the new t-direction only if the complete three-variable coefficient and boundary ledger survive the operation.

The independent Round-138 collar-tail cross owner remains outside the campaign. No result here alone proves lower GAR, either direct M1 parent, any M2 owner, endpoint uniformity, M9, the bridge, or a global exponent.

completion_criteria: Derive a literal dyadic T-D-E decomposition from at least one accepted C(st^2) parametrization, retaining multiplicity, parity, character, cone, coprimality, squarefree support, profile, block endpoints, and the large-displacement mask.
Verify the full three-variable derivative and Hessian ledger on every aspect-ratio box and identify all degenerating boundary faces, especially T=1, D=1, E=1, and the cone boundary.

Prove the strongest lawful three-variable van der Corput, Poisson, differencing, large-sieve, or decoupling estimate for the actual amplitude, including the cost of Mobius separation, sharp masks, partitions, and all dual or endpoint terms.
Determine an exact threshold T_0(M,N,D,E), if any, above which the complete aggregate is target-safe; a strict reduction is valid only if every complementary error and dyadic box is target-safe.
Audit primary source theorems against the exact dimension, monomial exponents, Hessian determinant, side lengths, coefficient class, smoothing, direction, fixed centre, and complete power ledger.
Test t=1, bounded t, T near M^(1/4), D or E short, balanced D and E, the exact radical, the N=sL^2+1 exceptional family, even parameters, terminal blocks, and the top M asymp R^2 block analytically.

Prove the target, produce a strictly smaller owner-complete bounded-t survivor, or identify the first rigorous coefficient/mask/aspect/source/power obstruction without turning an upper capacity into a lower bound.
Close under exactly one label: target_bound, strict_intermediate_t_dispersion_reduction, or three_variable_dispersion_no_go.

review_seams.requirement: The selected C(st^2) parametrization, multiplicity, parity, character, cone, squarefree and coprimality restrictions, mask, profile, and terminal endpoints remain literal.
The scaled Hessian determinant is computed correctly and no multidimensional estimate is used on a short or degenerate face outside its hypotheses.
Every T-D-E box, partition, coefficient-separation cost, dual term, endpoint, and dyadic sum is priced against X^epsilon.
The t=1 and bounded-t faces, exact radical, slow-frequency family, even cases, cone boundary, and top block are retained or separately discharged.
Every cited theorem matches the dimension, phase, side lengths, coefficient class, smoothing, fixed centre, and individual positive complex direction.
A strict survivor is promoted only after its complement is target-safe; the independent cross owner and all downstream M1, M2, endpoint, M9, bridge, and exponent claims remain separate.

closing_assessment.main_result: The masked small-t survivor is target-equivalent to the same scalar with the nearest-square mask removed. Its t-d-e phase has scaled Hessian determinant 1/4, but the exact coefficient is nonseparable, the mandatory t=1 and D=1 faces remain rank one, t-differencing returns rank-one phases with unproved coefficient correlations, and the full smooth transform self-returns at phase level. The strongest legal primary-source placements leave positive powers, including R^(1/16) for Cao--Zhai at the formal endpoint.
